obstruction: For a genuinely varying smooth-projective family and one exact rational Hodge class alpha, construct a coupled algebraic-witness incidence whose reduced image in each target irreducible Hodge component is (i) bound to alpha, (ii) closed, and (iii) top-dimensional. C005 proves these conditions would suffice for reduced local branch coverage but does not supply them generally.
why_reusable: The obstruction is phrased at the consumer image rather than at source tangent dimension, so any proposed Hilbert/Chow/normal-function/correspondence source can be tested against the same four coordinates before higher-order work begins.
required_coordinates: exact same-class binding for the signed rational witness
closed reduced image (proper/projective source is one sufficient route)
top-dimensional source image in that component
difference_witnesses: nonclosed dense proper image: same dimension without coverage
one component of a reducible Hodge germ: closed and full-dimensional but incomplete globally
wrong-class dominating source: base coverage without algebraicity of alpha
same reduced germ with different nilpotent structure: reduced coverage without formal/scheme-theoretic lifting
separate_downstream_obstructions: monodromy beyond the local marking and component switching

falsifier: A general construction satisfying all required coordinates for arbitrary signed rational alpha would resolve this obstruction; a counterexample to the C005 dimension lemma would invalidate the stated sufficiency certificate.
